extensionDescription.message: Connects the local omw daemon to this browser so agents can open tabs, read pages and act on them.

popupHint_unpaired.message: Pair this browser with the omw daemon.

popupHint_offline.message: Start the daemon with omw start.

popupHint_rejected.message: The daemon refused this browser. Pair it again.

example_summarize_prompt.message: Use oh-my-webbridge to read my active tab and summarize it in five bullet points.

example_form_prompt.message: Use oh-my-webbridge to fill in the form on my active tab with the details below, and stop before submitting.

example_research_prompt.message: Use oh-my-webbridge to open the three most relevant sources on this topic in background tabs, compare what they say, and close the session when you are done.

example_extract_prompt.message: Use oh-my-webbridge to extract the main table on my active tab as CSV.

setupSubtitle.message: Connect this browser to the omw daemon on this computer.

settingsSubtitle.message: Connection and page activity for this browser.

stepDaemonBody.message: Install omw on this computer, then start it.

stepDaemonService.message: To start at login, run omw service install instead.

stepPairBody.message: Run omw pair in a terminal and enter the code it shows.

pairInvalid.message: The code is wrong or expired. Run omw pair again.

pairOffline.message: The daemon stopped responding. Start it and try again.

pairRejected.message: The daemon refused the connection. Another profile of this browser may be connected.

stepScriptsBody.message: Firefox runs the evaluate action only after you allow user scripts.

stepTryBody.message: Install the agent skill so your agent knows the commands:

pauseDescription.message: Agents cannot use this browser while it is paused.

activityDescription.message: Edge glow, focus frame and favicon on pages an agent controls.

forgetDescription.message: Removes the token. Pair again to reconnect.
